title: Get 20TB of cloud storage for life for just $315
excerpt: Your cloud storage bill could be a thing of the past.
content_html:
TL;DR: Stop worrying about how you’re going to keep your files safe with this 20TB Scramble Cloud Storage lifetime subscription, on sale now for just $314.95 (reg. $1,440) through Oct. 11 with code CLOUD.

Credit: Scramble Cloud

$314.95
$1,440 Save $1,125.05

The best storage solution is one you don’t have to think about all the time. Scramble Cloud Storage serves up just that — allowing you to pay once and secure an ample 20TB of space for life.

Right now, you can even lock in that 20TB Scramble Cloud Storage lifetime subscription for just $314.95 until Oct. 11 with coupon code CLOUD.

If you’re tired of paying a small fortune in cloud storage fees year after year, it’s time to check out another option. Scramble Cloud Storage lets you own your space outright —offering long-term file freedom and peace of mind for a fraction of the price you’ve been paying to rent it.

This deal secures you 20TB of space, a high-capacity option designed for serious storage needs. Save your photos, videos, important files, and more right in the cloud without a second thought — for less than you’d pay to rent 6TB of iCloud storage for a year.

Aside from offering a more affordable option, Scramble Cloud Storage also provides peace of mind by using the Advanced Encryption Standard before uploading to the cloud. It also offers zero-knowledge architecture, so you’re the only person with access to your content.

An easy-to-use drag-and-drop interface ensures you can start using Scramble Cloud Storage right away. It has a familiar folder layout and works via a desktop client, WebDAV, CLI, or web app.

You can preview files instantly, share links, stream videos, and view Word and Excel files right in your browser.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Snag your lifetime subscription to 20TB Scramble Cloud Storage for just $314.95 until Oct. 11 with coupon code CLOUD.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
